claude_proposed_widenings.name: species_trait lineage-choice bundle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The unit is one species trait whose payload is chosen from a closed table of mechanically distinct lineage bundles. The current species_trait surface only supports one passive or activation payload, not a build-time choice among bundles.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: character-level gated trait grants
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The chosen lineage grants additional mechanics later at character levels 3 and 5. Current passive species traits cannot attach level thresholds to individual grants.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access spell-list choice with long-rest replacement
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf lineage grants a cantrip chosen from the Wizard spell list and allows replacing it after each Long Rest. Current grant_spell_access requires a fixed spellId and has no rest-based replacement/list-choice surface.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: trait-scoped spellcasting ability choice
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The lineage spells use a player-chosen spellcasting ability selected from a closed list. The current surface has no way to author a species-trait spell grant whose casting ability is chosen as Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage)."
